title: Answer
description:
God has sworn and will not relent. An oath outranks a law that was given without an oath.

The covenant is better because this Priest continues forever, not because the earlier servant was false.

He is able to save to the uttermost those who come to God through Him, because He always lives to make intercession. Intercession is bearing the people before God. A priest who dies cannot keep doing it.

Holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners: that could not be said of the priest who first had to offer for himself.

Perfected forever does not mean He became sinless. He was already without sin. It means the oath has finished His appointment as priest.
